live.title: Live transcription
live.parakeetHint: Parakeet uses Silero-VAD-driven streaming: text grows while speaking and freezes at pauses. The Parakeet server handles the segmentation.

final.title: Final transcription
final.thresholdHint: Replaces words in the final text with terms from the category's dictionaries when they sound alike and are spelled alike. The score is the mean of both (0–100). 85 is a good default; 90 corrects a little less but is even more cautious with very large dictionaries.

quality.title: Quality & anti-hallucination
quality.description: Prevents invented filler words during silence. Silence is always removed in the backend first (only speech is sent to the Whisper server); "VAD min. silence" sets the pause length used for cutting. The other values are passed on to the Whisper server.
quality.condPrevHint: Whisper is given the already recognised text of the previous section. This can make spellings more consistent but sometimes leads to repeated or invented sentences. Recommended: off.
